description: Returns direct media URLs for a tracked post, the video file, or slideshow images with positions. Accepts a public post URL or an internal post id. When media is not stored yet it queues an on-demand fetch and returns a jobRef to poll (typically ready within ~90 seconds); call again once complete. Platform CDN URLs can expire, so download promptly. YouTube currently returns the thumbnail image. You are responsible for using downloaded media in line with the platforms' terms and applicable law. Cost: 3 credits per call.
name: download_post_media
title: Download Post Media
